sentences.en: This is Jason Bateman, along with Will Arnett and Sean Hayes for the podcast called Smartless.
sentences.zh: 我是杰森·贝特曼，和威尔·阿奈特以及肖恩·海耶斯一起主持这档名为《聪明无极》的播客。

sentences.en: If that's a place you're looking for, you found it.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在寻找这样的地方，那你找对了。

sentences.en: It's not a real high concept podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个概念很高深的播客。

sentences.en: One person invites a guest, the other two don't know who that guest is, and then we chat.
sentences.zh: 一个人邀请一位嘉宾，另外两个人不知道嘉宾是谁，然后我们一起聊天。

sentences.en: I have two dogs, both sort of cat size, so I don't let them out that much.
sentences.zh: 我有两只狗，体型都跟猫差不多大，所以我不太常让他们出门。

sentences.en: So who does let the dogs out?
sentences.zh: 那到底是谁放狗出来的呢？

sentences.en: Wait, let them answer the goddamn, this thing has been, this is a question.
sentences.zh: 等等，让尼玛的他们回答，这事儿一直都是，这是一个问题。

sentences.en: I have a Brussels Griffon that's kind of like that dog in As Good As It Gets, Verdell, that goes down the trash chute that Jack Nicholson puts on.
sentences.zh: 我有一只布鲁塞尔格里芬犬，有点像《猫屎先生》里那只被杰克·尼科尔森塞进垃圾道、名叫韦德尔的狗。

sentences.en: And then there is a French bulldog named Hank, and that's my dude.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一只叫汉克的法国斗牛犬，那是我的好兄弟。

sentences.en: And do you have any references sort of post-96, or is that just, you like to stay in that?
sentences.zh: 你有没有96年之后的参考对象，还是说你就是喜欢停留在那个时期？

sentences.en: No, I don't think, oh, actually, yes.
sentences.zh: 不，我不觉得，哦，其实，有的。

sentences.en: The Brussels Griffon was featured in a commercial a year ago, I don't remember what it was.
sentences.zh: 布鲁塞尔格里芬犬一年前拍过一个广告，我不记得是什么广告了。

sentences.en: Oh, like a Darth Vader type of thing.
sentences.zh: 哦，就像达斯·维达那种风格的。

sentences.en: You really know how to spin a...
Wait, your actual dog or that type of dog?
sentences.zh: 等等，是你自己的狗还是那种品种的狗？

sentences.en: No, no, no, that type of dog.
You're not training your dog for film and TV right now.
sentences.zh: 你现在没有在训练你的狗去拍电影和电视吧。

sentences.en: No, but I'll bet you it's pretty lucrative.
sentences.zh: 没有，但我敢打赌那一定很赚钱。

sentences.en: I've never asked those animal trainers what they make, but I'll bet it's not a little.
sentences.zh: 我从来没问过那些动物驯兽师他们赚多少钱，但我敢说绝对少不了。

sentences.en: I made a kid's movie with a lot of dogs in it, Natasha, Leona, and I did, and how do I say...
sentences.zh: 我和娜塔莎拍过一部有很多狗的儿童电影，莱昂娜和我，然后我该怎么说呢……

sentences.en: Did that find a theater, or was it mostly on the television?
sentences.zh: 那是上映了院线，还是主要在电视上播的？

sentences.en: We'll save that for another show.
sentences.zh: 我们把这个留到以后再聊吧。

sentences.en: I feel like we're cutting you off, Sean.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们一直在打断你，肖恩。

sentences.en: We're staying on because we want to snap check from our guest when they sit down in one minute.
sentences.zh: 我们留下来是因为我们想在一分钟后我们的嘉宾落座时进行突击检查。

sentences.en: Then we'll get the hell out of your way.
sentences.zh: 那我们就不碍你的事了。

sentences.en: I don't mind looking at you two while we're doing this.
sentences.zh: 我们在做这个的时候，我不介意看着你们两个。

sentences.en: Surprise guest without saying anything verbally.
If you could snap or clap for us if you're there.
sentences.zh: 如果你在现场，请为我们打响指或鼓掌。

sentences.en: Guys, what a special episode this is.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，这一期节目太特别了。

sentences.en: Our guest today happens to have an album coming out December 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们今天的嘉宾有一张新专辑将于12月18日发行。

sentences.en: I've listened to it over and over again.
sentences.zh: 我已经听了一遍又一遍。

sentences.en: I love every track on it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢上面的每一首歌。

sentences.en: I can't wait to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待地想聊聊它。

sentences.en: The name of the album is McCartney 3.
The name of the guy is Paul McCartney.
sentences.zh: 这个人的名字叫保罗·麦卡特尼。

sentences.en: This is so cool for us.
He looks so much like Paul McCartney.
sentences.zh: 他长得太像保罗·麦卡特尼了。

sentences.en: He really does look like him.
I get told that all the time.
sentences.zh: 我经常听到别人这么说。

sentences.en: God, he sounds like him, too.
sentences.zh: 天哪，他的声音听起来也像。

sentences.en: Sir Paul McCartney, we'll get to you in one second.
sentences.zh: 保罗·麦卡特尼爵士，我们马上就跟你聊。

sentences.en: Sean, how did you do this?
How did you make this happen?
What the hell is going on?
Well, I'm telling you, Paul and I, we were in a pub throwing him back because we're both
sentences.zh: 嗯，我跟你说，保罗和我，我们在酒吧里畅饮，因为我们俩

sentences.en: We're going to get the real story.
sentences.zh: 我们会听到真实的故事。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're going to get the real story soon.
sentences.zh: 对，我们很快就会听到真实的故事。

sentences.en: Sean, keep quiet for a second.
I was just so humbled that you said yes to this.
sentences.zh: 你能答应来参加，我感到非常荣幸。

sentences.en: I like people to be humbled and a little bit frightened.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢让人感到谦卑又带点畏惧。

sentences.en: It is a tremendous honor to have you here.
sentences.zh: 你能来到这里，我们深感荣幸。

sentences.en: You probably don't remember, but we met briefly a couple of times, very briefly.
sentences.zh: 你可能不记得了，但我们以前短暂见过几次，非常短暂。

sentences.en: It was on a yacht, wasn't it?

sentences.zh: 我和所有人都短暂见过。

sentences.en: Paul, we're so flattered you're here today, and thank you.
sentences.zh: 保罗，你能今天来到这里我们感到十分荣幸，谢谢你。

sentences.en: It's really kind of surreal to be looking at you and talking to you because I've been
sentences.zh: 看着你并和你说话感觉真的有点超现实，因为

sentences.en: a fan like the rest of the entire world forever.
sentences.zh: 我和全世界所有人一样，一直都是你的粉丝。

sentences.en: But there's a billion questions I want to ask you.
sentences.zh: 但我有一肚子的疑问想问你。

sentences.en: Where does one start with questions?
The one I've always wanted to ask you for a very, very, very long time, and I'll just
sentences.zh: 我有一个非常、非常、非常久以来一直想问你的问题，我就
你怎么能保持这么好的身材？

sentences.en: I don't think I am, of course.
You look better than I did 20 years ago.
sentences.zh: 你看起来比我二十年前还要好。
我喜欢你们这几个小伙子。

sentences.en: Do you work out every day?
I do a little bit, yeah.
And I'm vegetarian, so maybe that's got something to do with it.
sentences.zh: 而且我是素食主义者，所以也许这有点关系。

sentences.en: Vegetarian, you can get sneaky fat having a bunch of pasta and a bunch of, right?
sentences.zh: 素食主义者，要是吃一堆意面和一堆别的东西，不知不觉就会胖起来，对吧？

sentences.en: You say you do a little bit of workout.
Yeah, just, what do I do?
sentences.zh: 对，就是，我都做些什么呢？

sentences.en: I have a very definite routine.
sentences.zh: 我有一套非常固定的日常。

sentences.en: I get on the mat, and I do a bunch of stuff there, like leggy, sort of.
sentences.zh: 我在垫子上做很多动作，比如有点像练腿的那些。

sentences.en: Rolling on the thing, on the river.
sentences.zh: 在那个东西上面滚动，在河上。

sentences.en: You know, rolling on a roller.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在一个滚轮上滚动。

sentences.en: I do a bit of that.
And then I do a bit of legs akimbo.
sentences.zh: 然后我做一个两腿分开的动作。

sentences.en: And then I move on to a cross trainer, elliptical.
And then I do, I mean, you know, I'm doing like five or ten minutes of these.
sentences.zh: 接着我做，我是说，你知道的，我大概做个五分钟或十分钟这些。

sentences.en: This is not a huge workout.
And then I do a bit of running.
And then I end with my favorite bit, particularly if I'm in a gym, because sometimes this is like a home gym.
sentences.zh: 接着我以我最喜欢的部分结束，尤其如果我在健身房的话，因为有时这就跟家里健身房一样。

sentences.en: But if I'm in a gym and all the big guys have got big weights and they're doing all the big stuff, at the end, I do a headstand.
sentences.zh: 但如果我在健身房，所有大块头都在练大重量、做那些高难度的动作时，最后，我做一个倒立。

sentences.en: And they come over to me.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会走过来找我。
是的，那真的很厉害，老兄。

sentences.en: I thought you were going to say, and I end with a birthday cake, which would be a fun.
sentences.zh: 我还以为你要说，我以一个生日蛋糕结束，那应该会很有趣。

sentences.en: I think this is going to be controversial.
I think that Sir Paul McCartney, you and I should put out an exercise video together.
sentences.zh: 我觉得保罗·麦卡特尼爵士，你和我应该一起出一套健身视频。

sentences.en: It would be very, because we could really.
sentences.zh: 这会非常，因为我们真的可以。

sentences.en: I think that people would like that.
That would be, yeah, that would be entertaining.
sentences.zh: 那会是，对，那会很有娱乐性。

sentences.en: He would spot you, or you would spot him, or would you just be snacking on stuff while he's doing some party?
sentences.zh: 他会保护你，还是你保护他，或者当他在那边练得热火朝天时，你就在一旁吃零食？

sentences.en: It sounds like he's in better shape than I am, so I think that I would be snacking.
sentences.zh: 听起来他的状态比我好，所以我觉得我大概会负责吃零食。

sentences.en: Paul, first of all, where are you right now?
sentences.zh: 保罗，首先，你现在在哪里？

sentences.en: And you're in your place in New York.
I'm actually in my office in New York.
sentences.zh: 其实我在纽约的办公室里。

sentences.en: Do you spend most of your time in New York?
sentences.zh: 你大部分时间都在纽约度过吗？

sentences.en: I'm between America and England, pretty much.
sentences.zh: 我基本上是在美国和英国两地跑。

sentences.en: But the thing is that I'm married to an American girl, Nancy, and so people say, you know, how much time do you spend in the countries?
sentences.zh: 但问题是，我娶了一个美国女孩南希，所以人们会问，你知道的，你在两国各待多长时间？

sentences.en: I used to say half and half, but now I say half and half.
sentences.zh: 我以前说各占一半，但现在我也说各占一半。

sentences.en: That's sort of, that's what it is.
sentences.zh: 差不多就是这样，就是这么回事。

sentences.en: I read that you spend most of your quarantine time, shocker, writing more music.
sentences.zh: 我看到报道说，你在隔离期间大部分时间都在写更多音乐，这倒不让人意外。

sentences.en: And to me, like, you know, I've never met you.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，呃，你知道，我从来没见过你。

sentences.en: I'm in awe of you, just like everybody else is.
sentences.zh: 我和其他人一样，对你敬佩不已。

sentences.en: And you think of like, I saw you say on Stephen Colbert once that you separate your fame from you.
sentences.zh: 你会想，我曾在史蒂芬·科拜尔的节目上听你说过，你把名气和真正的自己分离开来。

sentences.en: That you, that in your head, you're just, I just go work out and I'm nobody.
sentences.zh: 你，也就是在你的脑海里，你只是，我去健身，我只是个无名小卒。

sentences.en: But then there's this famous person that you remove yourself from.
sentences.zh: 但随后又存在着那个你与之保持距离的名人。

sentences.en: And that, that you kind of like, oh, I kind of like that guy's music.
sentences.zh: 然后那种，你有点像，哦，我还挺喜欢那家伙的音乐的。

sentences.en: You know, I think it's a, it's a safety measure.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得这是一个，这是一个安全措施。

sentences.en: I think, you know, I know I'm very famous.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，我知道自己非常有名。

sentences.en: I don't want to walk around like I'm very famous.
sentences.zh: 但我不想表现得一副自己很有名的样子走来走去。

sentences.en: Because I like that bit that I had when I grew up.
sentences.zh: 因为我挺怀念我成长过程中经历的那种生活的。

sentences.en: I'm just going on a bus and just being, you know, there's one good thing about the virus is everyone's got masks.
sentences.zh: 我只是坐着公交车，然后，你知道的，病毒带来的唯一好处就是每个人都戴着口罩。
对任何顶着一张名人脸的人来说都是如此。

sentences.en: But no, I do separate him from me.
sentences.zh: 但不对，我的确把他和我自己分开了。

sentences.en: So me, I don't like to take pictures when people say, can I have a picture?
sentences.zh: 所以至于我，当别人说“能拍张照吗？”时，我不喜欢拍照。

sentences.en: Because everyone's got a camera in the world.
sentences.zh: 因为现在世界上每个人都有相机。

sentences.en: Um, and so I say, I'm sorry, I don't do pictures.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我通常会说，对不起，我不拍照。

sentences.en: It's a line I got from watching Alec Baldwin once.
sentences.zh: 这是我以前看亚历克·鲍德温时学来的一句话。

sentences.en: We have this little thing with Lorne, Alec, and a couple of mates.
sentences.zh: 我和洛恩、亚历克还有几个朋友有个小圈子。

sentences.en: And it's called the Yoga Boys.

sentences.zh: 而且，我们的水平真的很烂。

sentences.en: I don't want to tangle with you guys.
sentences.zh: 我可不想跟你们几个较劲。

sentences.en: So, um, yeah, we're sitting around afterwards talking and we're having a bite to eat outdoors.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，对，我们练完后坐在一起聊天，在室外吃点东西。

sentences.en: Someone comes up to Alec and says, can I have an autograph for support?
sentences.zh: 有人走到亚历克跟前说，能给我签个名以示支持吗？

sentences.en: And he looks with that Alec look, he says, I'm sorry, I don't do pictures.
sentences.zh: 他用亚历克那标志性的眼神看着对方，说道，对不起，我不拍照。

sentences.en: And I just thought, that's the line.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，这就是界限。

sentences.en: I sometimes feel like I have to say, look, you know, I'm happy to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 我有时觉得我不得不说，听着，你知道的，我很高兴和你谈谈。

sentences.en: We can talk because I like that because I'm still me.
sentences.zh: 我们可以谈谈，因为我喜欢这样，因为我还是我自己。

sentences.en: The minute I put my arm around you, you put your arm around me, I feel like the monkey in Saint-Tropez.
sentences.zh: 只要我把胳膊搭在你肩上，你把胳膊搭在我肩上，我就觉得自己像圣特罗佩的猴子。

sentences.en: Come and have your picture taken with the monkey, you know?
sentences.zh: 来跟猴子合个影吧，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I love that you talk about this so openly, this idea of you being this person that you are.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴你能如此坦诚地谈论这一点，关于你作为现在的这个人的这种想法。

sentences.en: And there's a sort of humility to that.
Do you attribute that to where you grew up in Liverpool and your family and those kind of ideas that you've had from a young age that you've never let go of in a way?
sentences.zh: 你把这归功于你在利物浦的成长经历、你的家庭，以及你从小到大一直没有放弃过的那种理念吗？

sentences.en: So, you know, I was very lucky with my family, uncles and aunties, cousins and all of that.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我的家庭非常幸运，有叔叔、阿姨、表亲等等。

sentences.en: There were like millions of them.
My dad had seven in his family and my mom had two brothers and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸家里有七个兄弟姐妹，我妈妈有两个兄弟之类的。

sentences.en: So anyway, the minute they all start reproducing, it produced a big, big family.
sentences.zh: 总之，他们一开始繁衍后代，就变成了一个非常庞大的家庭。

sentences.en: They were so wonderful and wise and funny and optimistic.
sentences.zh: 他们是那么的精彩、睿智、幽默又乐观。

sentences.en: I really don't remember anything bad about it.
sentences.zh: 我真的想不起任何不好的事情。

sentences.en: So I grew up thinking that's how everyone's life is.
sentences.zh: 所以我从小就以为每个人的生活都是这样的。

sentences.en: And, you know, then when I met John, it turned out not to be true.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，当我遇到约翰时，结果并非如此。
他的成长经历非常糟糕。

sentences.en: His dad left home when he was three.
sentences.zh: 他三岁时他父亲就离家出走了。

sentences.en: His mother got run over and killed outside his aunt's place.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲在他阿姨家门外被车撞死。

sentences.en: But, yeah, so I do attribute that to my family upbringing.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，所以我确实把这归功于我的家庭教育。

sentences.en: And it is something I want to hold on to.
sentences.zh: 这也是我想坚持的东西。

sentences.en: And that instinct to hold on to that connection, that real human quality that we are all sort of one.
sentences.zh: 那种想要保持这种联系、这种我们其实是一体的真实人性的本能。

sentences.en: And it seems like you've got a real sort of love of people.
sentences.zh: 听起来你对人有着一种真正的热爱。

sentences.en: Do your level of fame and notoriety,
does it sometimes sadden you that other people who are just meeting you for the first time might have trouble or difficulty connecting with you on that level?
sentences.zh: 是否有时会让你感到难过，因为其他刚认识你的人可能很难或无法在那个层面上与你建立联系？

sentences.en: And do you then take it upon yourself to sort of try to put them at ease so that you can have that kind of, please see me as Paul and not as Paul McCartney.
sentences.zh: 然后你会不会主动承担起责任，试图让他们感到轻松，以便你们能进行那种交流，请把我当成保罗，而不是保罗·麦卡特尼。
我确实会那样做，你知道的。

sentences.en: Well, because I can't really sort of sit down and go, listen to this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为我不能真的坐下来就说，听听这个。

sentences.en: You know, we can't do that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们不能那样做。

sentences.en: And, you know, you ask them a question that you might think is quite boring.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你问他们一个你可能觉得很无聊的问题。

sentences.en: But sometimes they've got quite amazing stories.
sentences.zh: 但有时他们会有相当惊人的故事。

sentences.en: I was always very curious about that.
When I was a kid, I used to take a bus and just go for a few stops and get off and sit on a bench and just watch people and talk to people.
sentences.zh: 我小时候，经常坐公交车，坐几站就下车，坐在长椅上，看着人们，跟人们聊天。

sentences.en: In fact, I got arrested for it once.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我还因此被捕过一次。

sentences.en: So, Jason, a regular person is, just so we can try to put it in context for Jason.
sentences.zh: 所以，杰森，所谓普通人，这样我们就能试着给杰森讲清楚语境。

sentences.en: A regular person is somebody who did not grow up in show business.
sentences.zh: 普通人就是指没有在演艺界长大的人。

sentences.en: But, Paul, like, on the subject of fame, just because you made me think of something, have you found, do you ever find yourself, you especially,
sentences.zh: 但是，保罗，比如，说到名气这个话题，因为你让我想起了一些事，你有没有发现，你有时会发现自己，特别是你，

sentences.en: measuring time and your life by certain milestones or events, such as, like, the release of albums or concerts or whatever?
sentences.zh: 用某些里程碑或事件来衡量时间和生活，比如，专辑的发行、演唱会什么的？

sentences.en: And then, therefore, does that make the past feel like it's not that far away?
sentences.zh: 然后，因此，这会让人觉得过去其实并没有那么遥远吗？
